color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim from apple-mac. Selected for light register (pageBackground #ffffff, luminance 255 > 190).

type-system.twistDescription: B. Letter spacing injection: added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em. Heading sizes scaled ×1.15. All woff2 src blocks replaced with Google Fonts CDN imports (Manrope, EB Garamond, Overpass Mono). swiper-icons and VideoJS utility fonts removed. Font validation: all remaining fonts confirmed on Google Fonts list.

motion-system.twistDescription: A. Duration scaling (slower ×1.5): 0.2s→0.3s, 0.3s→0.45s, 0.5s→0.75s. Stagger step 0.1s→0.15s. Easing preserved. Languid, unhurried pacing.

grid-system.twistDescription: A. Container max-width tightened 10%: 1276px → 1149px. More editorial column measure. Responsive breakpoints preserved.

spacing-system.twistDescription: A. Global scale factor ×1.35: all numeric spacing values multiplied. Editorial generosity throughout — generous whitespace at section and hero levels.

interaction-states.twistDescription: E. Focus state enhancement: added outlineWidth: '2px', outlineStyle: 'solid', outlineOffset: '2px' to all focus states (buttons, inputs, links, navigation). Keyboard accessibility emphasized.

nav-system.twistDescription: D. Letter spacing on nav links: scaled from 0.08em to 0.10em. More deliberate, editorial nav presence. Height (86px/76px scrolled) preserved from ochre-ledger.

concept-summary.twistDescription: C.
